title: Sembcorp Changi NEWater Plant Begins Commercial Operations
lineage: Selected passages paraphrased from the cited text.

passages.note: Sembcorp announced on Monday 3 August 2009 that the first phase of Changi commercial operations had begun the previous Friday, 31 July 2009. Sembcorp was delivering NEWater to PUB. The release distinguishes the initial operating phase from anticipated completion of the whole plant in 2010.
